f.title: Comply with NTS 123 as a registration holder (mandatory scope)
f.statement: The Technical Health Standard NTS 123-MINSA/DIGEMID-V.01 is mandatory for, among others, holders of sanitary registrations and of sanitary registration certificates, who are responsible for complying with it insofar as it concerns them.
f.clause: III. Ámbito de aplicación (3.10) and 7.3.4
f.applicability: Medicines and other pharmaceutical products, medical devices and health products registered in Peru

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.quote: La presente Norma Técnica de Salud es de aplicación, obligatoria para:
rows.location: III. Ámbito de aplicación (3.10) and 7.3.4
rows.review_note: Review: scope row; quote is the scope heading, item 3.10 lists holders; 7.3.4 repeats responsibility. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: This Technical Health Standard is of mandatory application for:

f.title: Implement pharmacovigilance and technovigilance activities for products manufactured or marketed
f.statement: Holders must implement and carry out pharmacovigilance and technovigilance activities for the pharmaceutical products, medical devices and health products they manufacture or market.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario a)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario a)
rows.review_note: Review: "Corresponde a los titulares ... realizar las siguientes actividades" = Mandatory (mandatory standard). Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: a) Implement and carry out pharmacovigilance and technovigilance activities for the pharmaceutical products, medical devices and health products they manufacture or market;

f.title: Designate an in-country trained person responsible for pharmacovigilance and technovigilance
f.statement: Holders must designate and have available in Peru a person responsible for pharmacovigilance and technovigilance who is duly trained in pharmacovigilance and technovigilance.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario b)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.quote:
b) Designar y disponer en el país de un responsable de farmacovigilancia y
      tecnovigilancia debidamente capacitado en farmacovigilancia y tecnovigilancia;
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario b)
rows.review_note: Review: faithful. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: b) Designate and have available in the country a person responsible for pharmacovigilance and technovigilance, duly trained in pharmacovigilance and technovigilance;

f.title: Provide the PV responsible person with continuous information and training
f.statement: Holders must provide the person responsible for pharmacovigilance and technovigilance with information and continuous training on pharmacovigilance and technovigilance topics.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario c)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.quote:
c) Proveer al responsable de farmacovigilancia y tecnovigilancia, información y
      capacitación continua en temas relacionados a la farmacovigilancia y tecnovigilancia;
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario c)
rows.review_note: Review: faithful. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: c) Provide the person responsible for pharmacovigilance and technovigilance with information and continuous training on topics related to pharmacovigilance and technovigilance;

f.title: Implement safety measures ordered by DIGEMID (ANM)
f.statement: Holders must implement the measures ordered by the National Authority for Pharmaceutical Products, Medical Devices and Health Products (ANM, DIGEMID) regarding the safety of their products.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario d)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.quote:
d) Implementar las medidas dispuestas por la ANM en relación a la seguridad de los
      productos farmacéuticos, dispositivos médicos y productos sanitarios;
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario d)
rows.review_note: Review: faithful. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: d) Implement the measures ordered by the ANM in relation to the safety of pharmaceutical products, medical devices and health products;

f.title: Conduct post-authorisation safety studies when DIGEMID requests them
f.statement: Holders must conduct post-authorisation studies to generate additional information on product safety when the ANM requests them for safety reasons.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario e)
f.applicability: When requested by the ANM for safety reasons
f.processes: Epidemiology / safety studies; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario e)
rows.review_note: Review: faithful. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: e) Conduct post-authorisation studies in order to generate additional information on the safety of pharmaceutical products, medical devices and health products when, for safety reasons, the ANM so requests;

f.title: Archive all pharmacovigilance documentation adequately
f.statement: Holders must ensure adequate archiving of all documentation relating to pharmacovigilance and technovigilance responsibilities and activities.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario f)
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.quote:
f) Garantizar el archivo· adecuado de toda la documentación relacionada con las
      responsabilidades y actividades de farmacovigilancia y tecnovigilancia;
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario f)
rows.review_note: Review: OCR stray "·" kept verbatim in quote. No retention period stated. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: f) Guarantee the adequate archiving of all documentation related to pharmacovigilance and technovigilance responsibilities and activities;

f.title: Prepare periodic safety reports for products authorised in Peru
f.statement: Holders must prepare Periodic Safety Reports (Informes Periódicos de Seguridad) for pharmaceutical products and medical devices authorised in Peru in accordance with the regulations in force.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario g)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.quote:
g) Elaborar los Informes Periódicos de Seguridad para los productos farmacéuticos y
      dispositivos médicos autorizados en el país de acuerdo a la normatividad vigente;
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario g)
rows.review_note: Review: format/periodicity set by other regulations. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: g) Prepare the Periodic Safety Reports for pharmaceutical products and medical devices authorised in the country in accordance with the regulations in force;

f.title: Continuously evaluate the benefit-risk balance of products authorised in Peru
f.statement: Holders must keep the benefit-risk balance of their pharmaceutical products, medical devices and health products authorised in Peru under continuous evaluation.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario h)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario h)
rows.review_note: Review: item h) split: continuous evaluation here, 24-hour communication in the next row. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: h) Maintain a continuous evaluation of the benefit-risk relationship of the pharmaceutical products, medical devices and health products authorised in the country;

f.title: Communicate an important public-health risk to DIGEMID within 24 hours of detection
f.statement: On detecting an important risk to public health, holders must communicate it to the ANM within no more than twenty-four (24) hours.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario h)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.deadline: Within 24 hours of detecting the risk
rows.quote:
y, al detectar un riesgo importante para la salud pública,
      comunicar este hecho a la ANM en un plazo no mayor de veinticuatro (24) horas;
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario h)
rows.review_note: Review: faithful; 24 hours exact. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: and, on detecting an important risk to public health, communicate this fact to the ANM within a period of no more than twenty-four (24) hours;

deadline_rule.clock_start: al detectar un riesgo importante para la salud pública
deadline_rule.applies_to: Important public-health risks detected for authorised products

f.title: Establish standard operating procedures for pharmacovigilance activities
f.statement: Holders must establish standard operating procedures for pharmacovigilance and technovigilance activities.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario i)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.quote:
i) Establecer procedimientos operativos       estandarizados    para   las   actividades   de
      farmacovigilancia y de tecnovigilancia;
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario i)
rows.review_note: Review: faithful. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: i) Establish standard operating procedures for pharmacovigilance and technovigilance activities;

f.title: Detect, receive, code, record, evaluate and analyse suspected adverse reactions for reporting
f.statement: Holders must detect, receive, code, record, evaluate and analyse suspected adverse reactions and adverse incidents for the purpose of their notification.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario j)
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.quote:
j) Detectar, recibir, codificar, registrar, evaluar y analizar las sospechas de reacciones
      adversas e incidentes adversos, a efectos de su notificación correspondiente;
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario j)
rows.review_note: Review: faithful. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: j) Detect, receive, code, record, evaluate and analyse suspected adverse reactions and adverse incidents, for the purposes of their corresponding notification;

f.title: Report serious suspected adverse reactions to CENAFyT within 24 hours of knowledge
f.statement: Holders must send the evaluated, analysed and processed information on suspected adverse reactions and adverse incidents to the National Pharmacovigilance and Technovigilance Centre according to its procedures: serious suspected adverse reactions and adverse incidents must be reported on the forms approved by the ANM within twenty-four (24) hours of knowledge of the case, using the available means of communication.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario k) k.1
f.applicability: Serious suspected ADRs and adverse incidents

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.deadline: 24 hours from knowledge of the case
rows.quote:
k.1   Las sospechas de las reacciones adversas e incidentes adversos graves deben
            ser reportadas, en los formatos aprobados por la ANM, dentro de las veinticuatro
            (24) horas de conocido el caso, utilizando los medios de comunicación disponibles.
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario k) k.1
data_elements: date of knowledge of the case
rows.review_note: Review: origin "any" as the source does not distinguish (in practice domestic). Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: k.1 Suspected serious adverse reactions and adverse incidents must be reported, on the forms approved by the ANM, within twenty-four (24) hours of knowledge of the case, using the available means of communication.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Serious suspected adverse reactions and adverse incidents

f.title: Submit the investigation report on a serious suspected adverse reaction within 10 calendar days
f.statement: In addition, holders must submit, within no more than ten (10) calendar days from receipt of the notification, the investigation report on the serious suspected adverse reaction on the form approved by the ANM.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario k) k.1

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.deadline: 10 calendar days from receipt of the notification
rows.quote:
Adicionalmente remitir en el plazo no mayor a diez (10) días calendario, desde la
            recepción de la notificación, el informe de investigación de sospecha de reacción
            adversa grave en el formato aprobado por la ANM.
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario k) k.1
rows.review_note: Review: second time limit of k.1 kept as its own row. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Additionally, submit within no more than ten (10) calendar days from receipt of the notification the investigation report of the serious suspected adverse reaction on the form approved by the ANM.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Investigation reports on serious suspected adverse reactions

f.title: Report non-serious (mild and moderate) suspected adverse reactions within 20 calendar days
f.statement: Mild and moderate suspected adverse reactions or adverse incidents must be submitted within no more than twenty (20) calendar days of knowledge of the case, on the forms approved by the ANM.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario k) k.2
f.applicability: Mild and moderate (non-serious) suspected ADRs and adverse incidents

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.deadline: 20 calendar days from knowledge of the case
rows.quote:
k.2 Las sospechas de reacciones o incidentes adversos leves y moderados, deben ser
          remitidas en un plazo no mayor de veinte (20) días calendario de conocido el caso
          en los formatos aprobados por la ANM.
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario k) k.2
rows.review_note: Review: faithful. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: k.2 Suspected mild and moderate adverse reactions or incidents must be submitted within no more than twenty (20) calendar days of knowledge of the case on the forms approved by the ANM.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Mild and moderate suspected adverse reactions and adverse incidents

f.title: Follow up suspected adverse reaction notifications to complete information sent to CENAFyT
f.statement: Holders must follow up notifications of suspected adverse reactions or adverse incidents in order to complement, where applicable, the information sent to the National Pharmacovigilance and Technovigilance Centre.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario l)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario l)
rows.review_note: Review: OCR reads item letter l) as "1)"; quote verbatim. No time limit stated. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: l) Follow up notifications of suspected adverse reactions or adverse incidents in order to complement, where applicable, the information that was sent to the National Pharmacovigilance and Technovigilance Centre;

f.title: Inform CENAFyT within 24 hours of marketed batches posing a public-health risk
f.statement: Holders must inform the National Pharmacovigilance and Technovigilance Centre of marketed batches of products that pose a risk to public health within twenty-four (24) hours of becoming aware of the situation, using the available means of communication.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario m)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.deadline: 24 hours from awareness of the situation
rows.quote:
m) Informar al Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia y Tecnovigilancia los lotes
      comercializados de productos farmacéuticos, dispositivos médicos y productos
      sanitarios que impliquen un riesgo en la salud pública, dentro de las veinticuatro (24)
      horas de conocida la situación; utilizando los medios de comunicación disponibles;
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario m)
rows.review_note: Review: faithful. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: m) Inform the National Pharmacovigilance and Technovigilance Centre of marketed batches of pharmaceutical products, medical devices and health products that pose a risk to public health, within twenty-four (24) hours of becoming aware of the situation, using the available means of communication;

deadline_rule.applies_to: Marketed batches implying a public-health risk

f.title: Implement an information system on the safety of products authorised in Peru
f.statement: Holders must implement an information system on the safety of their pharmaceutical products, medical devices and/or health products authorised in Peru.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario n)
f.processes: Safety system configuration; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.quote:
n) Implementar un sistema de información sobre la seguridad de sus productos
      farmacéuticos y/o dispositivos médicos y/o productos sanitarios autorizados en el país;
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario n)
rows.review_note: Review: generic system duty (no vendor). Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: n) Implement an information system on the safety of their pharmaceutical products and/or medical devices and/or health products authorised in the country;

f.title: Conduct intensive pharmacovigilance when DIGEMID requests it for safety reasons
f.statement: Holders must carry out intensive pharmacovigilance of their products when the ANM requests it for safety reasons.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario o)
f.applicability: When requested by the ANM for safety reasons
f.processes: Epidemiology / safety studies; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.quote:
o) Realizar farmacovigilancia intensiva de sus productos farmacéuticos, dispositivos
      médicos y productos sanitarios cuando, por razones de seguridad, la ANM lo solicite;
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario o)
rows.review_note: Review: faithful. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: o) Carry out intensive pharmacovigilance of their pharmaceutical products, medical devices and health products when, for safety reasons, the ANM so requests;

f.title: Keep suspected adverse reaction notifications confidential
f.statement: Holders must maintain the confidentiality of notifications of suspected adverse reactions and adverse incidents.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario p)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.quote:
p) Mantener la confidencialidad de las notificaciones de sospechas de reacciones
      adversas e incidentes adversos;
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario p)
rows.review_note: Review: the same wording appears for several actors; this row is the holder duty in 6.7. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: p) Maintain the confidentiality of notifications of suspected adverse reactions and adverse incidents;

f.title: Prepare and implement risk management plans
f.statement: Holders must prepare and implement risk management plans in accordance with the regulations in force.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario q)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.quote:
q) Elaborar e implementar los planes de gestión de riesgo de acuerdo a la normatividad
      vigente;
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario q)
rows.review_note: Review: faithful. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: q) Prepare and implement risk management plans in accordance with the regulations in force;

f.title: Provide DIGEMID with pharmacovigilance documents or information on request
f.statement: Holders must provide the ANM, when required, with documents or information relating to the pharmacovigilance and technovigilance of their products authorised in Peru.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario r)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario r)
rows.review_note: Review: no time limit stated. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: r) Provide the ANM, when required, with documents or information related to the pharmacovigilance and technovigilance of their pharmaceutical products, medical devices and health products authorised in the country;

f.title: Communicate safety decisions by foreign regulatory authorities to DIGEMID
f.statement: Holders must communicate to the ANM decisions taken by other medicines regulatory authorities internationally relating to the safety of their products marketed in Peru.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario s)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.quote:
Comunicar a la ANM las decisiones asumidas por otras Autoridades Reguladoras de
      Medicamentos a nivel internacional relacionadas a la seguridad de sus productos'
      farmacéuticos, dispositivos médicos y productos sanitarios que se comercializan en el
      país;
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario s)
rows.review_note: Review: OCR stray apostrophe kept verbatim. No time limit stated. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: s) Communicate to the ANM the decisions taken by other Medicines Regulatory Authorities at international level relating to the safety of their pharmaceutical products, medical devices and health products marketed in the country;

f.title: Comply with Good Pharmacovigilance Practices and other PV rules
f.statement: Holders must comply with Good Pharmacovigilance Practices and the other rules on pharmacovigilance and technovigilance.
f.clause: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario t)

rows.actor: Holder of the sanitary registration or of the sanitary registration certificate (titular del registro sanitario / del certificado de registro sanitario)
rows.quote:
t) Cumplir con las Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia y demás normas referidas a la
      farmacovigilancia y tecnovigilancia.
rows.location: 6.7 Actividades de los titulares de registro sanitario y del certificado de registro sanitario t)
rows.review_note: Review: faithful. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: t) Comply with Good Pharmacovigilance Practices and other rules relating to pharmacovigilance and technovigilance.
